blind.description: A stylized fantasy dungeon/mine doorway structure. It consists of a thick, rough-hewn brownish stone outer frame (two vertical jambs and a heavy rectangular lintel divided into stone blocks) supporting an interior timber reinforcement. The wood frame features two vertical posts and an upper horizontal lintel held with wooden wedge brackets. Textures are hand-painted with brown rock, mossy green shading near the bottom, and dark weathered wood grain. Geometry is clean and solid with no floating, melted, or detached elements, and the base rests directly and flatly on the ground.
blind.from_above: A thick rectangular stone block cap split by a central seam, with a thin wooden lintel and two small bracket pegs protruding slightly along one long edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 7.5 to 8 feet tall (roughly 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide across the stone frame.
